script.problem: A quote isn't the BSB's exact words.

terra.problem: It gives a reason James placed the instruction next to the reference to Jesus. The text does not give that reason, even as a guess.
The potluck comparison brings up a meal outside the permitted food rule and assumes the baker has seen favoritism there.
The pillow and sore feet are presented as details of James's picture, but the text gives neither.
James describes a meeting but does not say it is indoors.
The text gives the man in fine clothes a seat of honor, not a cushion.
James does not say that the people in his example failed to notice what they had done.
James presents the seating as a hypothetical example. The explanation treats it as something the believers actually did and identifies the man offered the seat with those causing them trouble.
The passage does not say that the rich who oppress the believers are sitting close to them or in a seat of honor.
It supplies a reason James asks the question that the text does not give. Marking it as a guess does not make an invented reason permissible.
James's hypothetical poor man is told to stand or sit at the speaker's feet. The text does not say he was left standing.
The explanation guesses that James's point was to make the line short enough to remember. The text does not give that reason.
The statement that James talks about wisdom elsewhere needs a reference to that passage.
